runtime.session_policy: fresh application session; one first attempt per uniquely identified input

finding.symptom: HNNR can turn deep shadows into a regular 32 by 32 mosaic; downstream lens warping makes the grid appear curved.
finding.root_cause: The ISO exposed to Phocus selects an HNNR noise model. High Fuji capture ISO values are not a reliable model selector for transplanted Bayer data; ISO 8000 and 12800 reproduced the failure, while the same Bayer payload at ISO 6400 did not.
finding.signed_black_residual_status: Preserving signed sub-black residuals fixes an independent low-end information loss but is not sufficient by itself to prevent the high-ISO HNNR mosaic.

iso_ab_tests.result: first-attempt HNNR clean at +4 EV visual inspection
HNNR raw payloads are identical; no low-ISO remapping is justified

policy.capture_iso_preservation: Exact capture ISO and the complete source sensitivity fields remain in the JSON conversion record.
policy.disable_behavior: The exact capture ISO is written where the donor SHORT slot permits; values above 65535 use the EXIF 65535 sentinel while the exact value remains in the record.

claim: The high-ISO cap is a bounded compatibility policy supported by exact same-Bayer A/B tests and additional ISO 51200/102400 packaged-engine samples. It does not claim that ISO 6400 is a calibrated noise-equivalent transform or that every Phocus version will behave identically.
